name: What are the benefits of a built-in outdoor grill compared to a freestanding one?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of a built-in outdoor grill compared to a freestanding one?

acceptedAnswer.text: Built-in outdoor grills offer enhanced aesthetics, integrating seamlessly with your outdoor living space for a polished look. They provide greater durability and stability, as they are permanently installed within a custom structure. This also allows for integrated counter space, storage, and other amenities, creating a more functional and luxurious outdoor kitchen experience than a freestanding unit.
acceptedAnswer.description: Built-in grills offer superior aesthetics, durability, and functionality through integration into a custom outdoor kitchen structure.
